clue.text: Criminal gangs redirect delivery for an occasion

clue.text: Football fixtures that are unfairly moved?

clue.text: With surprised expression, boy turns up? He doesn’t

clue.text: In which to stick boxing memorabilia?

clue.text: One strolling across hill in the morning: one’s risky on the road

clue.text: Lowers head leaving the country, with all-consuming compulsion?

indicators.note: when the head leaves, the first letter goes

a European country

clue.text: In two languages, pasta and chips (no joints)

taken as written
hips are joints

clue.text: Air of excitement initially rising in excavation

clue.text: Part of paper suggesting hair dye?

clue.text: Magnificent plate put on table at intervals

second and fourth letters

clue.text: Most elegant to take meals in home?

clue.text: Yellow little house and ground

clue.text: Order this sort of pie?

clue.text: Be able to appear respectable: cancel being in court, or part of it

clue.text: What dog owners may need exhausts the shop

clue.text: Persecutor almost looks to turn sweet

clue.text: Optimist’s painful emotion at bereavement

clue.text: A god was relaxing with some pot
